name: list_avatar_groups
description: Returns a paginated list of avatar groups (characters). Each group contains one or more looks. Filterable by ownership.

ownership.title: Ownership

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (1-50).
limit.title: Limit

token.description: Opaque cursor token for the next page.
token.title: Token
